changelog: Device monitor now reads Input / AC / Solar / Output and battery straight from the device over pass-through every 5 seconds while the page is open, and stops the moment you leave.
The energy ring shows a whole-number battery percentage (61%, not 61.1%) so it matches the device card and the Real-Time Power badge — no more flicker between an integer and one decimal.
The icon you pick while adding a device (fridge, router, power strip …) now sticks instead of falling back to the lightning bolt.
The notification bell's red dot clears once you've opened Notifications and only shows for genuinely unread alerts.
The device-switcher chevron by the device name only appears when you have more than one device.
